description: Atlyn Calendar Slicer filters your report from a real month grid - seven columns, week rows, and adjacent-month days greyed for context - instead of the horizontal ribbon that date slicers usually give you. Click a day to filter to it, drag or Shift-click across days for a range, or Ctrl-click to pick scattered individual days that are not next to each other. Relative presets cover the periods people actually report on: Today, Yesterday, This Week, Last 7 / 14 / 30 Days, Month-to-Date, Quarter-to-Date, Year-to-Date, and Last Month / Quarter / Year. The rolling presets are applied as live relative-date filters, so a bookmark saved today still means "last 7 days" next month rather than freezing to the dates it was saved on. A visible Clear button removes the filter in one click. Bind an optional measure to heat-shade each day by magnitude on a low-to-high colour ramp, turning the grid into a density calendar for revenue, ticket volume, or bookings - and optionally grey out days that carry no data so nobody filters into an empty report. Heat-shading is off by default; enabling it binds a second field, which disables Power BI Sync slicers for this visual. Set the week to start on any day, show ISO-8601 week numbers down the side, shade weekends, align the grid to a fiscal year, and show one to four months at once.
